*[Bug 19113] New: Adding R_isForkedChild to API*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=19113>

            Bug ID: 19113
           Summary: Adding R_isForkedChild to API
           Product: R
           Version: R-devel (trunk)
          Hardware: Other
                OS: Other
            Status: UNCONFIRMED
          Severity: normal
          Priority: P5
         Component: Wishlist
          Assignee: <mailto:R-core@R-project.org|R-core@R-project.org>
          Reporter: <mailto:jeroenooms@gmail.com|jeroenooms@gmail.com>

The parallel package sets a global variable R_isForkedChild=1 to disable
certain behavior within a fork of the R process. This prevents fork() from
crashing some embedders.

It would like to request this to be allowed for packages as well (or some
wrapper that set this variable), such that packages can use fork() and get the
same behavior as the parallel package.

*[Bug 19049] btpe implementation rbinom has incorrect signs for error terms in Stirling approximation*
<https://bugs.r-project.org/show_bug.cgi?id=19049>

Martin Maechler (<mailto:maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch|maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch>) changed:

           What    |Removed                     |Added
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
             Status|CONFIRMED                   |CLOSED
         Resolution|---                         |FIXED

--- Comment #4 from Martin Maechler (<mailto:maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch|maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch>) ---
The fix (plus a regression test -- I did (use R simulations to) find a relative
simple example where the old and new code differ, i.e., the old code accepted a
proposal (in the acceptance-rejection scheme) number but the new code rejected
it, and hence needed one more uniform random number..

Committed in R-devel svn rev r90299, 90307, and 90310.

Note that such commits are now inspectable at R's source site, for a directly
intersting one, see
<https://svn.r-project.org/browse/R?manualorder=1&op=comp&compare%5B0%5D=%2Ftrunk&compare_rev%5B0%5D=90298&compare%5B1%5D=%2Ftrunk%2F&compare_rev%5B1%5D=90299&comparesubmit=Compare+Paths>

The biggest part of work was to add a new argument `binom.kind` to 
`RNGkind()`, in order to allow back compatible `rbinom()` usage:

In R-devel (and future R versions >= R 4.7.0), you will be able to choose
current (slightly) buggy `rbinom()` behaviour by
```
RNGkind(binom.kind = "Buggy BPTE")  
# or equivalently (for the time being)
RNGversion("4.6.1") # or even "3.6.0" etc, as the defaults have not changed for
a while.
```

Thank you, again, Kate, for your work, including detecting that problem had
actually been found in and fixed in the `gsl` sources;
notably *many* years ago (2003, by James Theiler ("jt"), I think) but had not
been told further.

Martin Maechler (<mailto:maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch|maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch>) changed:

           What    |Removed                     |Added
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
         Resolution|---                         |FIXED
                 CC|                            |maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch
             Status|NEW                         |CLOSED

--- Comment #1 from Martin Maechler (<mailto:maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch|maechler@stat.math.ethz.ch>) ---
Thank you, Kevin!

Your patch makes a lot of sense, as a bit later in the code, `PROTECT(*y)` also
needs to happen.

I've committed your patch + basically your example as a regression test --
notably making `f(TRUE)` much faster by letting it do (and cache!) the S4
dispatch already once outside the torture chamber.

This (and your other PRs) should alle be ported to the R-4-6-branch  to also
make it into R 4.6.2 (somewhere early fall or so).
